## Teaching points

1. An orthostatic headache after dural puncture warrants assessment for complications. Persistent disabling symptoms may justify an epidural blood patch.
2. Consider alternative causes when headache loses its postural character or new neurological or systemic signs appear.
3. Anesthetic assessment for an epidural blood patch is appropriate for disabling persistent symptoms. This intervention is outside the available order catalog.
